overview: The Medford City Council received a COVID-19 vaccination update, discussed plans for spring outdoor dining, and referred a proposal to expand the Board of Appeals to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Motorcycle Awareness Period Proclamation
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting the Mayor proclaim March 21 through April 30, 2021, as Motorcycle Awareness Period in Medford.

items.title: COVID-19 Vaccination Update
items.summary: Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor updated the Council on local vaccination progress and plans for a regional vaccination site at Tufts University's Gantcher Center.

items.title: Department Head Attendance and Budget Updates
items.summary: Councilors discussed scheduling updates from the police, fire, and DPW department heads in advance of upcoming municipal budget meetings.

items.title: Common Victualler's License for Dunkin' Donuts
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license transfer of ownership for Dunkin' Donuts at 7 Commercial Street.

items.title: Public Participation on Pay-to-Park Program
items.summary: Resident Robert Penta requested a complete accounting of revenues, expenses, and uncollected citations under the city's parking management contract.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Plan Update
items.summary: Chief of Staff Dave Rodrigues reported that the city will open applications on April 5 for seasonal outdoor dining and is drafting a permanent ordinance.

items.title: Birthday Recognition and Freedom Way Maintenance Resolutions
items.summary: The Council passed resolutions wishing Mary Paradiso a happy 93rd birthday and requesting DPW road and crosswalk repairs along Freedom Way before schools reopen.

items.title: Moment of Silence for Helen Alpers
items.summary: The Council held a moment of silence and dedicated the meeting to the memory of lifelong resident Helen Alpers.

items.title: Ghost Kitchen Regulatory Inquiry
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting information from the Board of Health and administration on regulatory requirements and meals tax collection for ghost kitchens.

items.title: Board of Appeals Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance amendment to expand the Board of Appeals from three to five voting members and two associate members to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: The Council accepted subcommittee reports covering housing stability initiatives, priority sidewalk snow removal plans, and ongoing zoning recodification work.

items.title: Special Permit Review Reports
items.summary: Approved completed special permit reviews for local businesses, while keeping pending hotel signage reviews tabled until opening.
